name: Jehoiada (Benaiah's father)
title: Priestly family head and warrior
summary: Jehoiada was the father of Benaiah, one of King David's most powerful warriors. He served as a leader among the Aaronites and was a prominent man in his time. His son Benaiah later became the commander-in-chief of Solomon's army.

keyEvents.title: Leader of the Aaronites
keyEvents.description: Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites who came to David in Hebron with 3,700 men.

keyEvents.title: Father's influence on Benaiah
keyEvents.description: Jehoiada raised his son Benaiah, who became one of David's three most powerful warriors and performed many heroic deeds.

keyEvents.title: Genealogical Record
keyEvents.description: Jehoiada is consistently mentioned as the father of Benaiah in the biblical genealogies, which underscores the importance of families in Israel.
